lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the fifth gill slit. The spots are arranged in a regular grid-like pattern with increasing inter-centroid distance moving posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct checkerboard appearance where spots serve as the primary vertices.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal line of elevated luminance is visible running parallel to the body axis on the upper flank, showing a clear vertical gradient with shadow formation on its ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior-distal margin of the pectoral fin displays significant irregular indentations and jagged tissue loss, indicating mechanical trauma or healed lacerations.
other_distinctive_markers: Cephalic region anterior to the gills exhibits a significantly higher density and smaller average diameter of high-luminance blobs compared to the mid-lateral flank.
